authoritativePricingRule.rounding: Nearest whole-dollar price ending in 9; if equidistant, ROUND UP
authoritativePricingRule.customerMedicationShipping: INCLUDED in retail; do NOT add pharmacy shipping again at website checkout
authoritativePricingRule.taxes: SEPARATE — not part of this calculation
authoritativePricingRule.pricingAuthority: Newest verified formulary medication cost + pharmacy shipping
authoritativePricingRule.multiplePairings: Calculate each verified pairing; do not silently choose. Single distinct (cost,ship) → authoritative. Else MULTIPLE_COST_BASIS_REVIEW. CHEAPEST label is pharmacy selection, not retail authority across different costs.
authoritativePricingRule.semTir: Each approved B12/Glycine tier priced from its exact formulary cost(s); keep B12 and Glycine separate
